scope: Stored straight-curve parameter vectors in eight saved scaled/variable-Fillet archives; initial entity namespace and existing unit-vector output retained

primary_reference.correspondence: The primary implementation retains the stored direction vector and evaluates origin plus parameter times direction; no normalizing step is applied.

limitations: No direct API native line-parameter getter was captured for these records.
Stored edge endpoints corroborate this parameterization; curve reversal, occurrence transforms and final/current state are not newly inferred.
Plane normals and other primitive axes retain their existing unit-vector checks.
